# crbirding

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/inbo/crbirding/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/inbo/crbirding/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/inbo/crbirding/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/inbo/crbirding)
[![test-coverage](https://github.com/inbo/crbirding/actions/workflows/test-coverage.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/inbo/crbirding/actions/workflows/test-coverage.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

crbirding is an r package to prepare bird colour ring data from European Colour-Ring Birding ([CR-Birding](https://submit.cr-birding.org/)) for publication to Global Biodiversity Information Facility ([GBIF](https://www.gbif.org/)). With crbirding you can transform data exported from CR-birding to Darwin Core.

To get started, see the [function reference](https://inbo.github.io/crbirding/reference/index.html).


## Installation

You can install the development version of crbirding from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("inbo/crbirding")
```
